AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Storage of Crop Produce? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Storage of Crop Produce.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Storage of Crop Produce.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Storage of Crop Produce.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Storage of Crop Produce.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Integrated Farming? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Integrated Farming.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Integrated Farming.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Integrated Farming.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Integrated Farming.

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Leftover Food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Leftover Food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Leftover Food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Leftover Food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Leftover Food.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

15. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Storage of Crop Produce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
